details.flavorMarkdown: *A lean, deep-chested tracking dog with a weatherproof coat, broad nose and attentive ears. Its loyalty is personal; a familiar handler matters more to it than a shouted order.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Keen scent within 6 squares; tracks by scent.

**Signs:** Claw marks beside a scent post; a bark that stops when answered.

**Purpose:** Stay with its familiar people and find the missing member of the pack.

**Tactics and retreat:** Circle an isolated threat and retreat toward its handler when hurt.

**Counterplay and conversation:** A familiar scent, food or a calm handler can stop a fight before it begins.

**Habitat:** Wilderness · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A collar can identify an owner; no automatic coin reward.

**Summoning:** Animal 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/summons/trail-hound.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-trail-hound


**Category:** Animal · **Role:** Tracker · **CV:** 5

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 1/2/4

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.1

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=5.000, O=1.324. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
